title: Shopify Dev MCP validation record (normalized consistency record)
description: A structured record of ONE Dev MCP validation call, referenced by an evidence artifact. NORMALIZED CONSISTENCY RECORD — not an authenticated capture of the Claude Code runtime. The single authoritative status is result.status (there is no separate event.status); the checker binds the event's fields to the evidence (same tool-call id, scoped tool, validator input by SHA-256, exact status) and requires a VALID result to carry no blocking errors. Genuine runtime provenance is proven only by the mandatory interactive cold-session test.

then.description: GraphQL validations must carry the Dev MCP conversationId and the Admin API surface.

tool_call_id.description: Tool-call event id; must equal the evidence validation's tool_call_ref.

tool.description: Fully plugin-scoped MCP tool name; must equal the evidence validation's mcp_tool.

api.description: The Dev MCP api surface for the call (e.g. 'admin' for Admin GraphQL).

conversation_id.description: The Dev MCP conversationId (from learn_shopify_api); bound to the evidence for graphql.

validated_input_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the actual validator input content; must equal the SHA-256 set of the evidence's validated_files.

result.description: The SINGLE authoritative result. status is an exact enum; a VALID result must have an empty errors array. summary is descriptive only and must not contradict status.
